guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at step 7/16 when trying to install bun via its install script: "error: unzip is required to install bun". The bun installation script requires the 'unzip' utility, which is missing in the current slim-based Docker image. To fix this, add 'unzip' to the apt-get install line in the Dockerfile along with other system dependencies. This should allow the bun install script to succeed and move forward with the build. The relevant Dockerfile snippet to update is: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl wget build-essential locales-all tzdata unzip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
